Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Unit U03 failed its check `yarn vitest run packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx` on all 3 attempts; the file is back to its pre-run state, so U03's two sites (S1: replace lines 35-85 to extend imports and updatePath(startPoint, points, boxSelectionMode?, keepPreviousSelection = false); S2: insert describe("Lasso boxSelectionMode") after line 1804) must be typed again in full. Last failure: `Lasso boxSelectionMode > enforces top-level, nested, off-screen, locked, and bound-text group rules in contain and overlap modes` -> AssertionError: expected true to be undefined at `expect(h.state.selectedElementIds[lockedMember.id]).toBeUndefined()` right after `updatePath(oneMemberStart, oneMemberPoints, "contain")`. Earlier attempts failed the same test with `expected { outer: true } to deeply equal { inner1: false, inner2: false, ... }` and `expected [ 'unlockedContainer', ...(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'unlockedContainer' ]`. Cause: the test's expectations are wrong, not lasso/utils.ts. Locked and bound-text members only stop counting as BLOCKERS of Wrap group completeness (FR-7); once the group qualifies, selectGroupsForSelectedElements (packages/element/src/groups.ts) adds EVERY member of the selected group to selectedElementIds, locked ones and bound text included, exactly as box selection does, and selectedGroupIds holds only the top-level selected group (e.g. { outer: true }), never inner groups set to false. Fix: assert the group is selected via h.state.selectedGroupIds and the unlocked members, do not assert that locked or bound-text members are absent, and do not assert inner groups in selectedGroupIds; or split this test into smaller cases (top-level, nested, off-screen blocker, locked non-blocker, bound-text non-blocker) with expectations that follow the group expansion above. Keep every existing test unchanged.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
